The '''Eruption Impasse''' was the name given to a branch of the [[White Maw Pass]], the volcanic fissure that lent its name to the [[Glacial Fissure]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The Impasse was named for the numerous volcanic vents that dotted the rift.
